causes.statement: Imaging service is overloaded, generating a pressure signal and a queue of 12 patients awaiting imaging, which is delaying multiple patients in zone 3.
Ward beds are overloaded and capacity unavailable, with no free ward beds and only one free ICU bed, causing patients to wait for suitable beds.
ED staffed space is nearly full (22 of 24 total, only 1 staffed space available), limiting ability to intake new patients and adding pressure on downstream services.
Discharge processing has a small queue (1 patient) but the reserve discharge slot is feasible and could reduce any hidden bottleneck in final patient flow.

proposals.title: Activate imaging reserve slot
proposals.rationale: Adds one extra imaging slot to relieve the overloaded imaging queue and reduce wait times for patients awaiting imaging.

proposals.title: Deploy staffed ED surge space (X1)
proposals.rationale: Provides an additional staffed ED space to increase capacity for incoming patients and alleviate pressure on triage and assessment.

proposals.title: Activate discharge reserve slot
proposals.rationale: Adds a discharge-processing slot to ensure any discharge bottleneck is cleared quickly, supporting overall flow.

proposals.title: Prioritize urgent imaging requests
proposals.rationale: Manually triage imaging orders so urgent cases are completed first, mitigating impact of the imaging overload on high‑acuity patients.

proposals.title: Temporarily repurpose free ICU bed for ward overflow
proposals.rationale: Use the one free ICU bed to accommodate ward‑bed‑waiting patients, reducing the ward‑bed backlog while a permanent solution is sought.

proposals.title: Implement rapid bed turnover protocol
proposals.rationale: Accelerate cleaning and preparation of vacated ward beds to increase effective bed availability and shorten wait times for boarding patients.
